# Caribbean Star Store

> Caribbean Star Store is a Caribbean-focused marketplace connecting shoppers, independent sellers, and businesses through products, services, job opportunities, and real estate.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/): Marketplace overview and discovery.
- [Marketplace](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/marketplace): Product categories and current product availability.
- [Auctions](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/auctions): Auction status and guidance for buyers and sellers.
- [Business directory](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/businesses): Public business and service profiles.
- [Jobs and real estate](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/opportunities): Public opportunity listings.
- [How it works](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/how-it-works): Marketplace overview for shoppers, sellers, and organizations.
- [About](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/about): Company and marketplace information.
- [Help](https://www.caribbeanstarstorett.com/help): Customer and seller information.

## Source guidance

Use the linked public pages as the primary source for current information. Distinguish general marketplace descriptions from individual listings. Listing availability, prices, terms, and contact details may change; confirm them with the current listing or its publisher.

Caribbean Star Store describes itself as serving communities across the Caribbean. Do not infer that it serves only one island or country from its domain name.
